name: AutoAnimeBot
description: Anime release and episode bot with owner-managed channels

MONGO_SRV.description: MongoDB connection URI for bot settings, users, and encrypted Telegram session.

OWNER.description: Numeric Telegram user ID allowed to run /login and channel-management commands.

API_ID.description: Optional Telegram API ID; the source default is used when blank.

API_HASH.description: Optional Telegram API hash; the source default is used when blank.

SEND_SCHEDULE.description: Post the airing schedule in configured main channels.

FFMPEG.description: FFmpeg executable path; defaults to ffmpeg.

LOG_ON_MAIN.description: Show transient processing status in the main channel instead of the log channel.
